base.title: Base currency
base.hint: Saldo shows «Total» and «Available» in it. It is changed in the space settings.

form.title: New rate
form.hint: A manual rate applies from the given date. It does not change the base-currency amounts of old operations. Saldo takes the NBU rate itself every morning. A manual rate wins the NBU rate of the same day; an older manual rate never beats a newer NBU rate.

list.title: All rates
list.empty: No rates yet. Without a rate, amounts in other currencies show as «?».

card.title: Rates
card.emptyHint: Saldo takes NBU rates every morning, they show here after the next update.
card.nonePinned: No currencies chosen for the overview
card.nonePinnedHint: Open «All rates» and tick up to three currencies.

sheet.title: Exchange rates
sheet.hint: Official NBU rates on {date}{base, select, UAH { against the hryvnia} USD { against the dollar} EUR { against the euro} other {}}. If you have your own rate that day, Saldo takes it. Tick the currencies to show on the overview.
sheet.hintNoDate: Official NBU rates. If you have your own rate on the rate's day, Saldo takes it. Tick the currencies to show on the overview.
sheet.limit: The overview fits 3 currencies. Untick one to add another.
sheet.notFoundHint: Try a code (PLN) or a name (zloty).
